steps.search: Search by name or scan a product code. The tour does not add products or create sales.
steps.cart: Select a product to add it to a sale and review quantities before collecting payment.
steps.total: Check products, quantities, taxes and total before continuing.
steps.payment: Select the payment method. Confirm only after reviewing the total and receiving payment. The tour never confirms payments.
steps.receipt: After confirming your sale, view or download the receipt shown in the POS.
steps.dashboard: Use Home to find your available tasks and pending work.
steps.inventario: Find products and check stock. Register products only with authorization and verified information.
steps.inventoryRead: View products and stock. Read access does not authorize inventory changes.
steps.levantamiento: Record physical counts and review differences before applying an authorized stock take.
steps.clientes: View the directory and register customer contact and tax details.
steps.ordenes_compra: View suppliers and purchases. Receiving goods requires authorization and updates stock.
steps.reportes: Review sales and results for your selected period; check filters before exporting.
steps.arqueo_caja: Review your cash drawer and movements. Count cash before confirming a closing.
steps.usuarios: Manage staff and review roles and permissions before saving changes.
steps.cotizaciones: View and prepare quotes. Creating or converting a quote requires the corresponding permissions.
steps.entregas: View pending deliveries. Confirm movements only after authorization and verification.
steps.pos: Search or scan products, add them to a sale, and check the total and payment method before charging. View the receipt afterwards.
steps.businesses: Create and manage businesses in the global panel. Each business keeps its users and data separate.
steps.modules: Open Services for a business to enable or disable modules; review dependencies and confirm the impact.
steps.branding: Open Branding or Configure business to set identity, navigation and the guided tour.
steps.subscriptions: Review each business plan and available settings.
steps.status: Review active or suspended clients and use the audit log to see who made changes.
steps.contacts: Register customers in this directory. For suppliers and authorized goods receipt, open Purchase orders in the menu.
steps.quoteRead: View available quotes. Creating quotes requires an additional permission.
